/zh/tours/fenghuang.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

想慢慢看古城的夜色和清晨，可以在凤凰住一晚。

我们怎么安排

衔接高铁、古城接驳、行李寄存和夜游船。

有变动联系谁

火车晚点或游船停航，联系预订通知上的罗途查联系人。

/en/tours/fenghuang.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Stay overnight to enjoy Fenghuang in the evening and again in the morning.

How we plan it

We coordinate rail times, transport into town, luggage storage and the evening cruise.

If plans change

For rail delays or cruise cancellations, use the LocalTourChina contact listed in your booking.

/zh/tours/fenghuang56.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

看完凤凰夜景就在古城住一晚，省去深夜返回张家界。

我们怎么安排

安排专车和最后一晚住宿，确认沱江夜游船时段。

有变动联系谁

停航时找随团导游核对可选安排和变更条件。

/en/tours/fenghuang56.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Stay overnight in Fenghuang after seeing the old town lit up.

How we plan it

We arrange the private transfer and final night and check the evening cruise schedule.

If plans change

If the cruise is suspended, ask your guide about alternatives and the change terms.

/zh/tours/furong.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

保留张家界住宿，只出门看一次芙蓉镇夜景。

我们怎么安排

把往返高铁、车站接驳、晚餐和夜景停留衔接起来。

有变动联系谁

车次有变找随团导游，确认晚餐和夜景怎么调整。

/en/tours/furong.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Keep your Zhangjiajie hotel and make an evening trip to see Furong lit up.

How we plan it

We coordinate the round-trip trains, station transfers, dinner and time at the waterfall after dark.

If plans change

If train times change, ask your guide how dinner and the evening visit can be adjusted.

/zh/local-guide.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

适合已安排车辆和门票、需要当地导游的游客。请先确认所需语言与档期。

我们怎么安排

确认见面时间、地点和讲解内容，基本时长为一天六小时。

有变动联系谁

时间或地点要改，请联系预订联系人。

/en/local-guide.html.detail:
Trip highlights

For travellers arranging their own transport and tickets. Confirm the guide language and availability before booking.

How we plan it

Confirm where to meet and what you want covered. The base service is six hours per day.

If plans change

Contact your booking team if the meeting time or place changes.

/zh/online-guide.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

想自由行，遇到中文地址、交通或付款问题时能找到人问。

我们怎么安排

行前可审阅一次行程，重大调整后可复核一次。

有变动联系谁

在北京时间 08:00–20:00 使用预订提供的线上联系方式。

/en/online-guide.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Travel independently with someone to ask about Chinese addresses, transport or payments.

How we plan it

The service includes one itinerary review before departure and one follow-up after a major change.

If plans change

Use the online contact in your booking from 08:00 to 20:00 China time.

/zh/private-tour.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

想自己安排自由活动，也希望有人协助关键环节。

我们怎么安排

先了解住宿、步行和饮食需求，再用行程草案和书面报价确认服务。

有变动联系谁

出发前找核对报价的联系人，确认行中联系人和支持范围。

/en/private-tour.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Keep time for your own plans while getting help with the parts you want arranged.

How we plan it

We discuss hotels, walking pace and food needs, then confirm the scope in a draft itinerary and written quote.

If plans change

Before departure, ask your quote contact to confirm who to reach during the trip and what support is included.

/zh/tours/regular34.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

只有三晚，优先看森林公园和天门山。

我们怎么安排

根据实际出机场时间和剩余入场时段，判断首日能否游览，并确认住宿。

有变动联系谁

航班延误，把新到达时间发给预订联系人。

/en/tours/regular34.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Only three nights? Prioritize the Forest Park and Tianmen Mountain.

How we plan it

We check when you can leave the airport and how much admission time remains, then confirm the first day and hotel arrangements.

If plans change

If your flight is delayed, send the revised arrival time to your booking contact.

/zh/tours/regular45.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

森林公园和天门山分两天，适合第一次来、带父母又想留出休息时间的客人。

我们怎么安排

按航班安排接送和首尾两天，结合云量、湿度、能见度及预约时段安排天门山。

有变动联系谁

天气有变，找随团导游确认入场和车辆能否调整。

/en/tours/regular45.html.detail:
Trip highlights

A good first visit with parents: see the Forest Park and Tianmen Mountain on separate days, with time to rest.

How we plan it

We plan transfers around your flights and look at cloud cover, humidity, visibility and entry slots before scheduling Tianmen Mountain.

If plans change

Ask your guide whether entry slots and transport can be changed if the weather turns.

/zh/tours/regular56.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

以张家界为主，多留一天给芙蓉镇。

我们怎么安排

结合开放时间安排山景和瀑布。遇雨先看石阶与开放情况。

有变动联系谁

到现场后，与导游商量走多远、留多久。

/en/tours/regular56.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Spend most of your time in Zhangjiajie and set aside a day for Furong.

How we plan it

We fit the waterfall visit around opening hours and check access and stone steps if it rains.

If plans change

Agree on walking distance and time in town with your guide.

/zh/tours/sanya-44.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

想留半天泡温泉，含市区往返和温泉门票。

我们怎么安排

先确认酒店接送范围、开放时间、泳衣和毛巾准备。

有变动联系谁

地点或开放时间有变，找预订通知里的联系人。

/en/tours/sanya-44.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Set aside half a day for the hot springs, with city transfers and admission included.

How we plan it

Check hotel pickup coverage, opening hours and whether to bring swimwear and a towel.

If plans change

For pickup or opening-hour changes, use the contact in your booking.

/zh/tours/sanya-45.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

半天看南山的寺庙和海景，含市区专车和英语导游。

我们怎么安排

按酒店位置安排接送，怕热或走不远的客人可先问园内交通。

有变动联系谁

需要园内代步，出发前找预订联系人确认。

/en/tours/sanya-45.html.detail:
Trip highlights

See Nanshan’s temples and coast in half a day with a private city transfer and an English-speaking guide.

How we plan it

Pickup depends on your hotel. Ask about transport inside the park if heat or walking is a concern.

If plans change

Check internal transport with your booking contact before departure.

/zh/tours/sanya-48.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

留出一整天，上午走雨林，下午看文化村。

我们怎么安排

遇雨先看雨林路况，并核对下午场地开放和门票范围。

有变动联系谁

雨天找预订联系人或现场导游确认可以走的路段。

/en/tours/sanya-48.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Set aside a full day for a rainforest walk and an afternoon cultural village visit.

How we plan it

Check trail conditions in wet weather, plus venue hours and admission details for the afternoon.

If plans change

Ask your booking contact or local guide which trails are open if it rains.

/zh/tours/sanya-49.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

只想看呀诺达雨林，半天就够安排。

我们怎么安排

提前问清开放步道、步行强度和额外体验是否另计。

有变动联系谁

遇雨找预订联系人确认开放路线和变更条件。

/en/tours/sanya-49.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Choose this half-day trip if Yanoda rainforest is your focus.

How we plan it

Ask ahead about open trails, walking difficulty and any separately charged activities.

If plans change

If it rains, check available trails and change terms with your booking contact.

/zh/tickets.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

交通和讲解自己安排，只需订景区票。

我们怎么安排

按日期、人数和入场时段核对票种与包含设施。

有变动联系谁

姓名拼写或时段有误，尽快找门票预订联系人查能否修改。

/en/tickets.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Book attraction tickets separately if you already have transport and guiding sorted.

How we plan it

We check the ticket type and included facilities against your travel date, party size and entry slot.

If plans change

Contact the ticket booking team promptly if a name or time needs correcting.

/zh/tours/trek34.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

三晚也想认真走一段山路，适合有一定步行习惯的客人。

我们怎么安排

提前了解步行和台阶接受程度。下雨后按开放路段和地面情况确定走法。

有变动联系谁

走累了尽早告诉导游，请他确认能否缩短或折返。

/en/tours/trek34.html.detail:
Trip highlights

A three-night trip for travelers who want time on the trail and are comfortable walking.

How we plan it

We ask about walking and stairs before departure and check trail access and footing after rain.

If plans change

Tell your guide early if you tire so they can check for a shorter route or turnaround.

/zh/tours/trek45.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

把山脊徒步当成重点，并接受随天气调整步行路段。

我们怎么安排

结合风力、路面和下山时间选路线，确认是否能缩短或中途会合。

有变动联系谁

风大或路滑时，找导游确认开放路段和折返点。

/en/tours/trek45.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Choose this for ridge walking and some flexibility if conditions change.

How we plan it

We check wind, footing and descent times, then assess where a shorter walk or regrouping may work.

If plans change

Ask your guide about open sections and turnaround points if it gets windy or slippery.

/zh/tours/trek56.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

想走山路，也想逛芙蓉镇，适合能应付石阶的客人。

我们怎么安排

把徒步和古镇的体力消耗一起考虑，分别确认雨天开放和路况。

有变动联系谁

徒步后如果腿累，第二天出发前和导游商量古镇步行范围。

/en/tours/trek56.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Combine mountain trails with Furong’s lanes if you’re comfortable on steps.

How we plan it

We plan around the effort of both outings and check access and footing separately in wet weather.

If plans change

If your legs are tired after the hike, agree on a shorter walk in Furong with your guide before setting out.

/zh/tours/furong45.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

四晚里兼顾张家界和芙蓉镇，适合能接受紧凑节奏的客人。

我们怎么安排

倒推瀑布夜景、返程和航班时间，先确认哪段可以调整。

有变动联系谁

改航班找预订联系人；途中改顺序找随团导游。

/en/tours/furong45.html.detail:
Trip highlights

See Zhangjiajie and Furong in four nights if you’re comfortable with a fuller schedule.

How we plan it

We plan around the waterfall visit, return journey and flights, and identify where there’s room to adjust.

If plans change

Contact the booking team for flight changes and your guide for changes on the road.

/zh/tours/forest.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

一天看袁家界和天子山，适合停留时间短的客人。

我们怎么安排

核对十里画廊、百龙天梯、园内接驳和天子山索道的衔接。

有变动联系谁

排队太久或设施停运，找预订通知里的现场联系人确认下山和演出接驳。

/en/tours/forest.html.detail:
Trip highlights

See Yuanjiajie and Tianzi Mountain in one day if you’re short on time.

How we plan it

We check how the Ten-Mile Gallery, Bailong Elevator, park shuttles and Tianzi cableway connect.

If plans change

If queues build or a lift closes, ask the on-site contact listed in your booking about the descent and onward transfer.

/zh/tours/tianmen.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

上午逛市场和市区，下午上天门山。

我们怎么安排

上山前看分时云量和能见度、入场及索道开放情况。

有变动联系谁

入场时段或索道有变，找预订中的现场联系人确认还能走哪些路线。

/en/tours/tianmen.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Spend the morning at the market and in town, then head to Tianmen Mountain in the afternoon.

How we plan it

We check cloud cover, visibility, your entry slot and cableway operations before the ascent.

If plans change

If your slot or the cableway changes, ask the on-site contact listed in your booking which routes are available.

/zh/tours/canyon.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

一天看黄龙洞和大峡谷，适合能走台阶的客人。

我们怎么安排

分别确认洞内游船和峡谷设施，衔接午餐与下午步行。

有变动联系谁

遇到关闭或不想走玻璃桥，问现场联系人可走哪段、在哪里会合。

/en/tours/canyon.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Visit Huanglong Cave and the Grand Canyon in one day if stairs are manageable for you.

How we plan it

We check the cave boat and canyon facilities separately and plan lunch around the afternoon walk.

If plans change

If anything closes or you prefer to skip the glass bridge, ask the on-site contact about routes and where to regroup.

/zh/services/airport-pickup.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

落地后直接去张家界市区或武陵源酒店。

我们怎么安排

按航班、酒店和行李确认会合点和车型。

有变动联系谁

晚点或找不到司机，把航班号和出口发给派车通知上的联系人。

/en/services/airport-pickup.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Go straight from the airport to a hotel in Zhangjiajie or Wulingyuan.

How we plan it

We confirm the meeting point and vehicle using your flight, hotel and luggage details.

If plans change

If delayed or unable to find the driver, send your flight number and exit to the dispatch contact.

/zh/services/airport-dropoff.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

带着行李从酒店直达机场，适合返程当天。

我们怎么安排

结合酒店、航班及办理手续所需时间确认出发点和时间。

有变动联系谁

航班改时，把新起飞时间告诉派车联系人。

/en/services/airport-dropoff.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Get from your hotel to the airport with your luggage on departure day.

How we plan it

We confirm pickup time and place around your hotel, flight and time needed for check-in.

If plans change

Send the revised departure time to your dispatch contact if the flight changes.

/zh/services/station-transfer.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

适合带行李往返张家界西站和酒店。

我们怎么安排

核对车次、到达时间、出口和酒店位置。

有变动联系谁

晚点或走错出口，把车次和当前出口发给派车联系人。

/en/services/station-transfer.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Travel between Zhangjiajie West station and your hotel with your luggage.

How we plan it

We check your train, arrival time, station exit and hotel location.

If plans change

If delayed or at a different exit, send your train number and current exit to the dispatch contact.

/zh/services/day-charter.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

景点自己逛，把约定路线的开车和等候交给司机。

我们怎么安排

先选森林公园、天门山或峡谷等线路，并核对演出后的返程。

有变动联系谁

想增加停靠点或延长等候，找调度确认和问费用。

/en/services/day-charter.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Explore on your own while a driver handles travel and waiting on the agreed route.

How we plan it

Choose a route such as the Forest Park, Tianmen Mountain or the canyon and confirm the ride back after any show.

If plans change

Check availability and charges with dispatch before adding stops or extending the wait.

/zh/vehicles.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

只需要接送或带司机的一日用车，可以单独订车。

我们怎么安排

用人数和大件行李确定座位和装载空间。

有变动联系谁

人数或行李变化，找派车联系人核对车型。

/en/vehicles.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Book transport only, from a one-way transfer to a day with a driver.

How we plan it

We check seating and luggage space based on your group and bags.

If plans change

Tell dispatch if your party size or luggage changes so they can check the vehicle.

/zh/services/furong-transfer.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

在芙蓉镇自由逛，只订拼车或包车。

我们怎么安排

拼车核对班次与余位，包车核对人数和希望返程的时段。

有变动联系谁

拼车留意约定发车时间，包车想延时可找调度询问。

/en/services/furong-transfer.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Explore Furong independently with a shared or private ride.

How we plan it

For shared rides, check the departure and seats. For a private car, confirm group size and preferred return time.

If plans change

Check your shared departure before extending the visit, or ask dispatch about extra waiting for a private ride.

/zh/services/fenghuang-transfer.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

住宿自己订，需要车辆前往凤凰，可选过夜后返回。

我们怎么安排

过夜往返按次日上午九点前从凤凰出发核对。

有变动联系谁

酒店或出发时间变了，找调度确认车辆能到哪里及费用。

/en/services/fenghuang-transfer.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Arrange your own hotel and book a car to Fenghuang, with an optional return after an overnight stay.

How we plan it

The overnight return is planned around leaving Fenghuang by 9 a.m. the next day.

If plans change

If your hotel or pickup time changes, ask dispatch about vehicle access and any cost change.

/zh/services/changsha-transfer.html.detail:
这款行程适合谁

长沙与张家界之间带行李直达，适合想省去换乘的客人。

我们怎么安排

核对长沙站、长沙南站或黄花机场航站楼，以及张家界实际住宿点。

有变动联系谁

车站或航站楼有变，把新地点和时间发给派车联系人。
/zh/services/changsha-transfer.html.credit: 长沙南站资料照 (2015) · Doraemon.tvb / Wikimedia Commons · CC BY-SA 3.0 · 按画面比例裁切

/en/services/changsha-transfer.html.detail:
Trip highlights

Travel directly between Changsha and Zhangjiajie with your luggage.

How we plan it

We confirm the exact railway station or Huanghua Airport terminal, and the hotel at the other end.

If plans change

If your station or terminal changes, send the updated location and time to your dispatch contact.
